partition_dataset: split an annotated dataset into k shuffled partitions for cross-validation
create_train_valid_split: create train and validation splits from k dataset chunks for a given fold index
run_k_fold_cv_setup: run the script to partition a dataset and generate k-fold cross-validation train/valid splits
refactor_partition_dataset: refactor partition_dataset to use pathlib instead of string concatenation for file paths
review_create_train_valid_split: review create_train_valid_split to ensure correct k-fold cross-validation logic
